title: Table 3.9b Maximum overshadowing for narrow lots (rear half of the adjoining site)

rows.note: no maximum on the front half; 35% of the rear half
no maximum on the front half; 55% of the rear half
R80 and higher: no maximum overshadowing

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Two keys: the adjoining lot must be coded R40 or greater AND have a frontage of 7.5 m or less; any other adjoining lot has no row (NOT_APPLICABLE, C3.9.1 governs). Battleaxe adjoining lots are excluded by a rule condition, not here. Figure 3.9e: the rear half is the half of the lot depth furthest from the street.

verified.note: R40 rear half 35%, R50-R60 55%, front half no maximum; R80 and higher no maximum. Frontage key 7.5m or less from C3.9.3(ii).
